description:
Every US strategic bomber ever built is documented here in chronological order, from the experimental Barling Bomber of the 1920s through the jet age and beyond. This video traces the design decisions, engineering trade-offs, and procurement realities behind each aircraft — why some flew, why some were scrapped, and what the Army Air Corps and later the Air Force actually got for their money. You will see how requirements changed, how contractors succeeded or failed to meet them, and how each bomber shaped the next. A factual, no-filler reference for serious students of American airpower history.

Subscribe for more from Designed vs Used.
